column1: # ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO DATA -- NOT DESIGN RAINFALL. DO NOT REPORT.
# Burst depths (mm) by duration (h) and AEP (fraction)
# log-normal curve to the annual exceedance series of station 418005's own
# cumulative maximum along duration so depth increases with burst length.
# A fit to a few years of a single gauge is both biased and imprecise
# extrapolating it past the tabulated range is meaningless. ARR design rainfalls
# are regionalised from the whole gauge network and reach AEPs no single record
# can support. This file exists so examples/dffa_demo.py and run_dffa() have an
# IFD to run on. For anything you intend to report
# a table of this layout and read it with ifd_table_from_csv().
